name: @lumithink/poc-dsh-child
description: R0-01/R0-02 PoC: validate the pinned DeepSeek Harness TypeScript SDK against an isolated, explicitly allowlisted lumithink-child profile, with a fail-closed zero-skip acceptance gate. Synthetic data only — never import real child data.

scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test-isolation=none --test tests/manifest.spec.ts tests/mock-model.spec.ts tests/privacy/child-env.spec.ts tests/security/profile-whitelist.spec.ts tests/security/egress-guard.spec.ts tests/contracts/sdk.e2e.spec.ts tests/security/negative-tool.spec.ts
scripts.test:r0:run: node -e "fs.mkdirSync('reports',{recursive:true})" && node --experimental-strip-types --test-isolation=none --test --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=reports/r0-01-acceptance.xml --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout tests/manifest.spec.ts tests/mock-model.spec.ts tests/privacy/child-env.spec.ts tests/security/profile-whitelist.spec.ts tests/security/egress-guard.spec.ts tests/contracts/sdk.e2e.spec.ts tests/security/negative-tool.spec.ts
scripts.test:r0:gate: node --experimental-strip-types src/report-gate-cli.ts summarize reports/r0-01-acceptance.xml && node --experimental-strip-types src/report-gate-cli.ts check reports/r0-01-acceptance.xml
scripts.test:r0: pnpm run test:r0:run && pnpm run test:r0:gate && pnpm run test:r0:gate-tests && pnpm run test:r0:egress && pnpm run test:r0:sanitize
scripts.test:e2e02:gate: node --experimental-strip-types src/e2e02-gate-cli.ts summarize reports/e2e02-bridge.xml && node --experimental-strip-types src/e2e02-gate-cli.ts check reports/e2e02-bridge.xml
scripts.test:e2e02: pnpm run test:e2e02:run && pnpm run test:e2e02:gate && pnpm run test:e2e02:sanitize
scripts.test:e2e03:gate: node --experimental-strip-types src/e2e03-gate-cli.ts summarize reports/e2e03-gateway.xml && node --experimental-strip-types src/e2e03-gate-cli.ts check reports/e2e03-gateway.xml
scripts.test:e2e03: pnpm run test:e2e03:run && pnpm run test:e2e03:gate && pnpm run test:e2e03:sanitize
